msg: Hola, buen día. Somos un grupo de 7 amigas de Bogotá. Tres ya tenemos el Open Water, dos quieren probar el minicurso y dos prefieren snorkel. ¿Cuánto saldría por persona saliendo desde Cartagena y hay descuento por grupo?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Buen día! ¡Qué chévere plan para las siete! Sí, pueden combinar buceo certificado, minicurso y snorkel en la misma salida; el snorkel se hace en una zona distinta a la de buceo.

Te dejo a continuación los precios por persona saliendo desde Cartagena. Para el grupo de siete, el descuento de grupo es del 10% y se suma al 10% online para buceo recreativo, minicurso y snorkel. Hay que solicitarlo al equipo antes de pagar; no aplica a cursos PADI.

Como son de Bogotá, el pago sería en pesos colombianos.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Minicurso de Buceo: 655.000 COP · 727.000 COP
• Tour de Snorkeling: 448.000 COP · 497.000 COP
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 630.000 COP · 700.000 COP
• Paquete de 3 inmersiones (1 día, 2 diurnas + 1 nocturna): 1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP

No hay descuento ni tarifa especial por ser colombiano: el precio es el mismo, solo cambia la moneda (COP).

¿Quieres que te pase con un asesor para organizar la reserva?

msg: Hello. My wife and I arrive on a cruise ship in Cartagena on March 3rd, docking at 7:00 am and we must be back on board by 5:00 pm. We would both like to snorkel. Is that doable? We are from Canada.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Snorkeling in the Rosario Islands is a lovely experience, but the Cartagena tour won’t fit your cruise schedule: it departs at 8:00 a.m. from Muelle de la Bodeguita and returns to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m., leaving too little time to get back on board by 5:00 p.m. The departure time is fixed and can’t be moved earlier.

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

Diving Planet policies:
- Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers). The refresher is also 18 hours: it is for certified divers, even though it is booked as the mini course. The hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. The mini course dive ends around 12:00 (noon): its 12 hours count from then. If the last dive is a daytime one, the refresher's included (activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), you can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day; after the mini-course, from midnight that same day. If the last dive is a night dive, the hours count from it. A flight the next day at 7:00 a.m. or later IS fine: they can dive the day before, and that day's return time to Cartagena changes nothing. For a certified diver, a flight on the SAME day as the dive NEVER works, whatever the time, even at night: with a flight on Sunday night, the last dive must be on Saturday at the latest; the boat being back before they leave does not fix it. If they say they leave that day without saying how, they are probably flying: tell them this. When answering, first say from what time they can fly and then compare it with their flight; do not start with yes or no.
- If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly. The refresher is the mini course (pool and one dive with an instructor) and takes its own day: the dive trip cannot be done that same day. Anyone staying several days does the refresher on the first day and dives on the others.
- For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
- Muelle de la Bodeguita, 5 minutes from the historic center, at 8:00 AM. Departing from Cartagena there is no hotel pick-up: each person gets to the dock on their own (ground transportation to the dock is not included).
- By booking you accept our terms and conditions, cancellation policy, and data treatment. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Date changes are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Changes to the number of people on a booking you already made are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Colombians (anyone with Colombian nationality, holding a Colombian cédula or passport, wherever they live; also dual nationals when one nationality is Colombian) and residents of Colombia (holders of a cédula de extranjería, a resident ID; living in Colombia without one is not enough) pay in Colombian pesos (COP). Saying they are Colombian or from a Colombian city ("I'm from Cali") already says it; what is not enough is only having been born there while living abroad: then ask whether they hold Colombian nationality or a cédula de extranjería. All other international clients pay in US dollars (USD). A group does not pay in parts: if the same booking mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group pays in US dollars (USD), residents and Colombians included. A Colombian together with someone who holds a cédula de extranjería, wherever they are from, is not a mixed group: both pay in pesos (COP). The price is the same: only the currency changes (there is no discount for being Colombian).
- If the group mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group booking is paid in US dollars (USD), at the same equivalent price. Someone with a cédula de extranjería does not count as a foreigner, wherever they are from. There is no different price for being Colombian.
- If you are already on the Rosario Islands, we coordinate pick-up and drop-off from hotels with maritime access. In some cases the boat arrives directly at the hotel; in others we indicate the nearest dock or meeting point.
- These plans have different prices because they do not include transport from Cartagena or lunch.
- Pick-up is only on the Rosario Islands: Barú (including Playa Blanca, which is on Barú) is not part of the islands and we do not operate or pick up there; guests staying in Barú depart from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita).
- It depends on the activity: snorkeling from 6 years old; Bubble Makers from 8 to 10 years old (pool mini-course and very shallow water practice, max 2 meters); the dive mini-course and the Open Water course from 10 years old; the Advanced course and the Rescue course from 12. Minors must be accompanied by a demonstrable parent or responsible relative.
- The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
- If you are a certified diver, there are no additional medical restrictions; your liability waiver is the certified-diver one: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). For the refresher day this one is not used: use the course medical form.
- Bringing or drinking alcohol on the boat or during the activity is not allowed, and no alcohol or other substances may be consumed before diving. You must be in good physical condition.
- The booking system on our website. It automatically closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you can no longer book for the next day, and you still book on the website for the next available day.
- To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
- From Cartagena: departure at 8:00 a.m. from Muelle de la Bodeguita and return at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.). From the islands: hotel pick-up between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m. (8:00 a.m. for specialties and 7:30 a.m. on day 2 of some courses). Daytime activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m. (see the activity schedule). Night diving: in the evening (pick-up around 5:30 p.m., back around 7:30 p.m.). Online booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before; after that, you book on the website for the next available day.
- We only close on December 25 and January 1. The rest of the year we operate every day, including public holidays, except for suspension due to adverse weather conditions.
- The tour includes water all day, coconut candy between dives, and lunch (rice with chicken or rice with vegetables). The menu is always the same, it does not change by day/supplier. Vegetarians, vegans, and celiacs receive rice with vegetables. Guests may bring their own food if needed (e.g. allergy or special diet). If the guest has a food allergy, they must inform us before the tour. In multi-day packages departing from Cartagena, lunch is included on the first day only; plans for guests already on the islands do not include lunch.
- Photos and videos are not offered proactively or included in the price. The instructor may take them voluntarily and delivers them by the next day at the latest. Any tip to the instructor for photos/videos is voluntary: each guest gives whatever they like, directly to them. This applies to every activity, including the mini-course (and the refresher, booked as a mini-course), PADI courses and certified-diver trips: not included, the instructor may take them voluntarily.
- The 3, 4, 5, 7 and 9 dive packages are exclusively for certified divers with a minimum Open Water level. They are not available for uncertified beginners.
- Two-day courses (Open Water, Referral Course, Advanced, Rescue and Mindful Diving) require accommodation on the islands: at least one night, the night of day 1 (there is no return to Cartagena on day 1). There is no option to commute from Cartagena on both days. Accommodation is not included and must be booked directly with the hotel. The same goes for multi-day dive packages (4, 5, 7 and 9 dives): you stay on the islands, and accommodation, which is not included, is booked directly with the hotel.
- Private services and closed groups are available, with no fixed price (it depends on the group and the date). A member of our team prepares the quote and coordinates an available instructor for the date.
- Through DIVE TO HEAL, more than 360 people with disabilities have been served. Accepted conditions include: hearing impairment (deaf), visual impairment (blind), reduced mobility (wheelchair), Down Syndrome, Cerebral Palsy, and Autism (depending on level and assessment). All instructors are trained in adaptive diving. Advance notice is recommended. The limitation is the presence of additional medical conditions that contraindicate diving.
- If you're already on the Rosario Islands and your hotel has maritime access, boat pick-up and drop-off are included at no extra charge.
- We dive in the Rosario Islands, inside the Corales del Rosario y San Bernardo National Natural Park, about 45-60 minutes by boat from Cartagena.
- All daytime activities (dive trips, mini-course, snorkeling, courses and each day of the packages) end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., followed by lunch. Guests departing from Cartagena have lunch included on the islands and the boat returns to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.); guests staying on the islands return to their hotel around 12:00-1:00 p.m. for lunch (lunch not included). On overnight courses and packages, day 1's daytime activities also end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., and then you go to your hotel on the islands. Night diving (on plans that include it) is separate, in the evening (see each plan's schedule).
- There is always availability (confirmed by the business). We only close on December 25 and January 1, and a trip can be suspended due to adverse weather. The date and number of people are chosen in the booking link. To book for the next day, you need to do it before 4:30 p.m. (see booking system cutoff). Booking for the SAME day is no longer possible (trips leave in the morning and the website closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before): you book for the next available day.
- Each person can bring one backpack or bag on the boat. If the guest needs to bring a suitcase, it has to be arranged with a member of our team. If they prefer not to take it, we can store the suitcase at our office in Cartagena.
- What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
- At our base on the island there are lockers where you can leave your things (clothes, phone, wallet) while you dive or snorkel.
- There is no minimum number of people: every activity runs even for a single person.
- Activities and courses are taught in Spanish and English. If a participant speaks neither language, they can come with someone who interprets for them, but instruction is still given in Spanish or English.
- Bookings are made on our website, through each activity's link (with the 10% online discount). The system closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you still book on the website, for the next available day. Plans with no booking link (the 3- and 4-dive packages, the 9-dive package from the islands, the 1-dive trip from the islands, Bubble Makers, Divemaster and the private service) are booked by an advisor in this chat.
- Besides the insurance form, each diver fills in a liability waiver. Our team sends it to you to complete (certified divers: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish)), and the confirmation email reminds you if you have not done it yet.
- The mini-course is a one-day try-dive, an introduction to diving: it does not certify, does not count as part of any PADI course and requires nothing from PADI beforehand (no PADI account or PADI online course). It is the same departing from Cartagena or already on the islands: there is no online or emailed theory; the theory is done there, on the day, along with pool practice and 1 ocean dive with an instructor.
- International clients pay 100% by card on the website; with a foreign card the passport is used as the ID document.
- Colombians and residents of Colombia (including holders of a cédula de extranjería) pay in pesos and do not use the website booking link: a team advisor always closes the booking in this chat and sends them the link, QR code or Llave to pay 100% online or a 50% deposit, and the other 50% on the day of the activity, by card or cash. The 50% deposit option is only for them. Nobody pays 100% at the dock without booking online.
- If you leave the next day around noon: from the Rosario Islands it is very tight (pickup is between 9:30 and 9:45 and the activity ends around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), so it is best to confirm it with a team advisor; departing from Cartagena it does not fit (the boat returns at 3:00 p.m. and arrives around 4:15 p.m.). To book for the next day you must do it before 4:30 p.m. the day before.
- Customers paying in US dollars book and pay through the online link: the payment is recorded right away and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking; only if the online payment fails does the team send a link to pay by transfer.
- If the booking system or the online payment fails, our team sends you a link to pay by bank transfer, and the 10% online discount is kept (because the online payment failed). Outside that case there is no payment by transfer: the 10% discount is for booking and paying online.
- In groups combining diving and snorkeling, snorkeling takes place in a different area from the dive sites. If there are few people everyone goes on the same boat; otherwise the group is split by activity.
- Besides our base (Hotel San Pedro de Majagua and Hotel Cocoliso, on Isla Grande), other hotels in the area with maritime access are Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras and Pao Pao. Accommodation is not included: it is booked directly with the hotel.
- To book an activity departing from the islands, the customer must already have their hotel and tell us which one: pickup is arranged there. If they don't have it yet, they first book the hotel and message us with its name; then we book. If they booked the activity first, the hotel could be cancelled, it could be full, they could forget to tell us or end up departing from Cartagena. If they stay in a house, an Airbnb or a hotel not on our list, they tell us the name and an advisor confirms the pickup before they book and pay: they do not book until then.
- Returning to Cartagena on a different date from the plan is not included. If the guest wants to stay longer on the islands and come back with us another day, a member of our team arranges it (space on the boat, etc.).
- Departure and pickup times are fixed: they cannot be moved earlier or later. If you need an adjustment, a team advisor reviews it.
- Cancellations due to bad weather are unlikely because the Rosario Islands are in sheltered waters. If the Port Authority (Capitanía de Puerto) closes departures to the islands, we first try to reschedule the activity so you don't lose your booking. If rescheduling is not possible, you get a 100% refund. See the terms and conditions: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Scuba diving is not possible during pregnancy: no mini-course, no dive trips and no courses (DAN and obstetricians advise against it for the whole pregnancy). Surface snorkeling is possible, with her doctor's approval. Whoever comes with her can dive as usual.
- If you get seasick on the boat (the ride to the islands is about 1 hour by speedboat): have a light breakfast before leaving and consider seasickness tablets. If you take any medication, ask your doctor whether you can dive with it.
- We do issue invoices (also to companies). An advisor from our team coordinates the invoice details with the customer.
- There is no maximum age for diving: an older person can dive with the same medical form as everyone else.
- We carry oxygen and a first-aid kit on board, with trained staff, and there is an emergency protocol.
- Groups are small and follow PADI safety standards for each activity.
- The boat is a regular speedboat with no bathroom. On the islands we use the facilities of the hotel where lunch is served: that is where you change, use the bathroom and shower.
- Diving Planet has no parking of its own; there are public car parks in the old town area, and the easiest way to reach the pier is by taxi.
- There is no gift card, but you can book in someone else's name; the date and details are arranged with an advisor.
- Smoking is not allowed on the boat.
- Pets are not allowed on the boat: we go to a National Natural Park.
- Babies and young children who are not yet old enough for any activity (snorkeling starts at 6) can ride the boat with their parents at any age, and they ride free.
- You can bring your own camera on the dives or snorkeling, at your own risk. Diving Planet does not rent cameras.

msg: Solo yo. ¿A qué hora me recogerían en el Cocoliso y tengo que llevar algo? Gracias.
reply:
En Cocoliso te recogerían entre las 9:30 y las 9:45 a. m. y regresarías al hotel hacia las 12:00–1:00 p. m. Lleva tu carné de buceo, bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo está incluido. 🐠

También necesitas:
• Estar listo a las 9:30 en tu hotel
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente. El refresher es el minicurso (piscina y una inmersión con instructor) y ocupa su propio día: ese mismo día no se hace la salida de buceo. Quien viene varios días hace el refresher el primero y bucea los demás.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.

¿Han pasado *más de 2 años* desde tu última inmersión?

msg: Good afternoon. I am from Germany and I hold an Open Water certification, although I have not dived for three years. I am staying in Getsemaní and I would like to dive next Wednesday. My flight home leaves on Thursday at 22:00. Is this possible, and what would you recommend?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Good afternoon! Since you’re certified and haven’t dived for three years, the recommended option is a **refresher**. After it, you need to wait at least **18 hours from your last dive** before flying. If your refresher dive ends around 12:00–1:00 p.m. on Wednesday, you can fly from **7:00 a.m. Thursday**, so your 22:00 flight meets the waiting period.

From Cartagena, the activity returns to the city around 4:15 p.m. The 10% online discount is applied automatically when booking through our website.

One important detail: the booking system closes at **4:30 p.m. the day before**.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

Would you like the booking link for the refresher?

It’s booked as the Dive Mini Course: [book the refresher](https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en).

msg: Good, thank you. Two last questions: do you pick me up in Getsemaní or how do I reach the dock, and do I have to bring my certification card or fill in any forms for these two days?
reply:
There’s no hotel pick-up in Getsemaní. Please make your own way to **Muelle de la Bodeguita** for **8:00 a.m.**; ask for **DIVING PLANET at entrance 3**. It’s about five minutes from the historic center. [View the meeting point](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Muelle+de+la+Bodeguita/@10.4199447,-75.5537609,828m/data=!3m2!1e3!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x8ef62f753729822d:0x1bbcdd8224d0eaaf!8m2!3d10.4199447!4d-75.551186!16s%2Fg%2F113gzkckf?entry=ttu)

Please bring your **certification card**; you can show it on the day. For the refresher, you’ll need the **course medical form** (even though you’re certified) and the insurance form sent with your booking confirmation. There’s no theory to complete beforehand; the instructor covers it on the day. The certified-diver liability waiver isn’t used for the refresher.

You'll also need:
• The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
• If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly. The refresher is the mini course (pool and one dive with an instructor) and takes its own day: the dive trip cannot be done that same day. Anyone staying several days does the refresher on the first day and dives on the others.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.

The *refresher* is an instructor-led review before diving again: it is booked as the *Dive Mini Course* and costs *183 USD* per person who needs it. It uses the course medical form (even for certified divers; the link comes with the booking). Are you interested?

Sí, pueden hacer dos salidas de un día: cada una incluye 2 inmersiones y el regreso a Cartagena ese mismo día. El punto de encuentro es el Muelle de la Bodeguita a las 8:00 a. m.; la lancha regresa a las 3:00 p. m. y llega aproximadamente a las 4:15 p. m.

Hay que solicitarlo al equipo antes de pagar; no se aplica automáticamente. No calculo un total con el descuento, porque el equipo debe aplicarlo al cerrar la reserva.

Para quienes llevan equipo, el **5% por equipo propio** aplica solo si cada uno trae el equipo completo. Como son dos salidas, pueden comparar con el equipo cuál opción de descuento les conviene más; el equipo debe confirmar el valor final antes del pago.

🤿 *Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día)*
💰 *630.000 COP* por persona · 6 personas
_Son 2 salidas de un día: se reserva una por día._

El pago es en pesos colombianos (COP): pueden pagar *100 % online* o un *anticipo del 50 %* con el enlace, el QR o Llave que envía el asesor, y el *otro 50 % el día de la actividad*.

⚠️ Si alguno lleva *más de 2 años* sin bucear, se añade el *refresher* (el minicurso: piscina y una inmersión con instructor): *655.000 COP* por persona. ¿Es el caso de alguno de ustedes?

msg: Buenas tardes. Mi esposa y yo venimos de Medellín a Cartagena de luna de miel y nos gustaría probar el buceo. Nunca lo hemos hecho y nos da un poquito de nervios. ¿Cuánto cuesta y qué incluye? Nos estamos quedando en Bocagrande.
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Qué bacano celebrar la luna de miel con una experiencia en el mar! Como nunca han buceado, pueden hacer el **Minicurso de Buceo**: incluye entrenamiento en piscina y una inmersión en el arrecife con instructor PADI. El instructor los acompaña durante todo el proceso, así que pueden ir paso a paso.

**Incluye:** transporte en lancha Cartagena–Islas del Rosario–Cartagena, equipo de buceo, seguro, entrada al Parque Nacional Natural, almuerzo y aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL. No incluye el transporte terrestre hasta el muelle, fotos o videos, propinas ni comida adicional.

El punto de encuentro es el **Muelle de la Bodeguita a las 8:00 a. m.**; desde Bocagrande deben llegar por su cuenta. Te dejo el precio a continuación.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Minicurso de Buceo: 655.000 COP · 727.000 COP
• Tour de Snorkeling: 448.000 COP · 497.000 COP

¿Quieren que les ayude a continuar con la reserva?

msg: Gracias. Nos interesa el minicurso, para los dos. ¿A qué profundidad se baja? Y mi esposa pregunta si hace falta saber nadar muy bien, porque ella nada lo justo. Quisiéramos ir el sábado 14 de noviembre.
reply:
El minicurso llega hasta **12 metros**; lo habitual es bucear entre 5 y 12 metros. La profundidad exacta depende del punto de buceo elegido.

También necesitas:
• No hay teoría que hacer antes: se hace allí, el mismo día, con el instructor.
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 12 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

No hace falta saber nadar muy bien para hacer el minicurso, pero no tengo aquí el requisito específico sobre el nivel de natación. Como ella nada lo justo, es mejor confirmarlo con el equipo antes de reservar.

🤿 *Minicurso de Buceo*
💰 *655.000 COP* por persona · 2 personas

El pago es en pesos colombianos (COP): pueden pagar *100 % online* o un *anticipo del 50 %* con el enlace, el QR o Llave que envía el asesor, y el *otro 50 % el día de la actividad*.

msg: Perfecto, gracias, espero entonces lo del asma. Mientras tanto, otra duda: tengo que estar en Bogotá el lunes para trabajar. Si hago el curso sábado y domingo, ¿puedo coger un vuelo el domingo por la noche, cuando vuelva a Cartagena? Y sobre la teoría, ¿tengo que estudiar algo antes de ir?
reply:
Para el Curso Open Water, debes esperar al menos 18 horas desde tu última inmersión antes de volar. Así que un vuelo el domingo por la noche no sería compatible con bucear ese mismo domingo; que la lancha llegue a Cartagena alrededor de las 4:15 p. m. no cambia ese tiempo de espera.

Sí, debes completar antes la teoría de PADI eLearning, que toma aproximadamente 10 a 12 horas. También necesitas alojarte al menos una noche en las islas; el alojamiento no está incluido.

También necesitas:
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

Para preguntas médicas específicas, es importante que hables con nuestro staff calificado para evaluar tu situación particular. Te paso ahora con alguien del equipo, que te escribe por aquí enseguida.

msg: Hey! Planning a bachelor party in Cartagena in February, there will be 6 of us from Texas. Three of the guys are certified and three have never dived. We want one day out on the water together. What's the deal price-wise for a group like ours? And can we pay with US credit cards? One of us would pay for everybody.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

That sounds like a great bachelor-party plan! For one day from Cartagena, the three certified divers can do Fun Dives, while the three who haven’t dived can choose a Dive Mini Course, snorkeling, or come along as companions. You can all be out on the water together, though the activities differ.

I’m leaving the per-person prices below. Your group qualifies for the 10% group discount, which must be requested before paying; it can combine with the 10% online discount for eligible activities. The group discount doesn’t apply to PADI courses.

Yes, international guests can pay by card on the website, and one person can pay for the group. Payment is made in full online; with a foreign card, use the cardholder’s passport as the ID document.

msg: Good call on asking: one of the certified guys, Mike, last dived about three years ago. The other two dived last summer. No beers, got it. So what does Mike need to do? And who do I talk to on your team to get the group discount before we pay?
reply:
Mike is still certified and can join the certified dives. Since it’s been about three years, a refresher is normally required. It’s a pool session and one dive with an instructor, takes its own day, and can’t be done on the same day as the dive trip. If he has already completed a refresher or PADI ReActivate at another centre, that counts. He’ll need to bring his certification card and complete the course medical form: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol

To get the group discount, ask the team before paying. The 10% group discount applies to groups of 5 or more and stacks with the 10% online discount for a 20% total discount when booking online. It isn’t applied automatically, and it can’t be added after payment. Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor?

You'll also need:
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
• After diving, wait at least 12 hours before flying

Keep in mind that the mini-course is a one-day introduction and does not certify you; to get certified there is the Open Water course (2 days, with a night on the islands).

msg: Good afternoon. My name is Anna, I am from Germany. I will stay at the Hotel San Pedro de Majagua on Isla Grande from November 20 to 24. I am a PADI Advanced diver with about 80 dives, my last dive was in September in Egypt. How does it work when I am already on the island: do you pick me up at the hotel, and what does it cost? I would like to dive on two of the days.
reply:
Hi, Anna! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Good afternoon, Anna! Diving on two days from Isla Grande is a lovely way to explore the reefs. Since San Pedro de Majagua is one of our island bases, pick-up and return by boat are included.

For two days of daytime diving, the 4-dive package includes two dives each day. Pick-up is between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m.; you’ll return to your hotel around 12:00–1:00 p.m. Lunch isn’t included for island-based plans. I’m leaving the price options below.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 3 daytime + 1 night dive): 236 USD · 262 USD
• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD

From the islands we coordinate pick-up and drop-off at your hotel if it has maritime access, or at the nearest dock we point you to.

Would you prefer daytime dives only, or would you like to include a night dive?

msg: Yes, the 4-dive package with daytime dives sounds right, on November 22 and 23. My flight home leaves Cartagena on November 24 at 16:00. Is this safe after diving? And could I go with your boat from the island to Cartagena that morning, or do I need to arrange this myself? I also have one large suitcase.
reply:
You can fly from 7:00 a.m. on November 24, since the 18-hour wait is counted from your last dive on November 23. Your 4-dive package ends around 12:00–1:00 p.m. each day, so the November 24 flight at 4:00 p.m. is after the required interval.

The package includes pick-up and drop-off at San Pedro de Majagua, as it’s one of our base hotels. Returning to Cartagena on November 24 is a separate boat arrangement, though, and isn’t included in the package. A team advisor would need to arrange the boat space and confirm whether your large suitcase can be accommodated. Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor about the return trip?

Diving Planet policies:
- Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers). The refresher is also 18 hours: it is for certified divers, even though it is booked as the mini course. The hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. The mini course dive ends around 12:00 (noon): its 12 hours count from then. If the last dive is a daytime one, the refresher's included (activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), you can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day; after the mini-course, from midnight that same day. If the last dive is a night dive, the hours count from it. A flight the next day at 7:00 a.m. or later IS fine: they can dive the day before, and that day's return time to Cartagena changes nothing. For a certified diver, a flight on the SAME day as the dive NEVER works, whatever the time, even at night: with a flight on Sunday night, the last dive must be on Saturday at the latest; the boat being back before they leave does not fix it. If they say they leave that day without saying how, they are probably flying: tell them this. When answering, first say from what time they can fly and then compare it with their flight; do not start with yes or no.
- If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly. The refresher is the mini course (pool and one dive with an instructor) and takes its own day: the dive trip cannot be done that same day. Anyone staying several days does the refresher on the first day and dives on the others.
- For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
- Muelle de la Bodeguita, 5 minutes from the historic center, at 8:00 AM. Departing from Cartagena there is no hotel pick-up: each person gets to the dock on their own (ground transportation to the dock is not included).
- By booking you accept our terms and conditions, cancellation policy, and data treatment. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Date changes are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Changes to the number of people on a booking you already made are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Colombians (anyone with Colombian nationality, holding a Colombian cédula or passport, wherever they live; also dual nationals when one nationality is Colombian) and residents of Colombia (holders of a cédula de extranjería, a resident ID; living in Colombia without one is not enough) pay in Colombian pesos (COP). Saying they are Colombian or from a Colombian city ("I'm from Cali") already says it; what is not enough is only having been born there while living abroad: then ask whether they hold Colombian nationality or a cédula de extranjería. All other international clients pay in US dollars (USD). A group does not pay in parts: if the same booking mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group pays in US dollars (USD), residents and Colombians included. A Colombian together with someone who holds a cédula de extranjería, wherever they are from, is not a mixed group: both pay in pesos (COP). The price is the same: only the currency changes (there is no discount for being Colombian).
- If the group mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group booking is paid in US dollars (USD), at the same equivalent price. Someone with a cédula de extranjería does not count as a foreigner, wherever they are from. There is no different price for being Colombian.
- If you are already on the Rosario Islands, we coordinate pick-up and drop-off from hotels with maritime access. In some cases the boat arrives directly at the hotel; in others we indicate the nearest dock or meeting point.

Answer: Yes, diving is safe when procedures and training limits are followed. The basic rules are: never hold your breath, ascend slowly, always dive with a buddy, equalize early and often, respect depth limits, constantly monitor your air, and follow the instructor or guide. Question: Are fish, sharks, starfish, coral, or sea urchins dangerous?
Other ways to ask: Is it dangerous to encounter sharks, fish, or sea urchins while diving? / Should I be concerned about marine animals like coral or starfish when diving?
Answer: Most fish avoid humans. If you see a shark, the recommended approach is to stay calm, observe, and enjoy the moment from a respectful distance; encounters are usually safe. Touching starfish, turtles, coral, or any organism is not recommended: many are delicate or sensitive. Many minor diving injuries occur from accidental contact with coral or sea urchins, which is why neutral buoyancy and not touching anything are fundamental for safety.

msg: Okay, thanks. So who can tell me about the GoPro? I'd really like to film my first dives, it's kind of the whole point for me. And is storing my backpack at your office free? A 9:00 a.m. flight the next morning would be too soon, so please check with a team advisor about your plans before booking.

msg: ¿Me tocaría hacer algún repaso antes? ¿En qué consiste y cuánto cuesta en pesos?
reply:
Sí, como llevas unos 4 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un repaso. El *refresher* es el minicurso: incluye práctica en piscina y una inmersión con instructor, y ocupa su propio día; ese mismo día no se hace la salida de buceo. Como estarás varios días, puedes hacer el repaso el primero y bucear los demás. Si ya hiciste un refresher o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu repaso.

También necesitas:
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.
• Ser buzo certificado y presentar tu carnet

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Minicurso de Buceo: 655.000 COP · 727.000 COP
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 630.000 COP · 700.000 COP
• Paquete de 3 inmersiones (1 día, 2 diurnas + 1 nocturna): 1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP

¿Para cuántas personas sería: solo para ti o van más? 😊

msg: Buenas tardes, somos una familia de Ciudad de México con tres hijos de 7, 11 y 14 años. Mi esposo y yo no tenemos certificación. ¿Qué actividades podemos hacer todos en las islas?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

Las Islas del Rosario son un plan muy chévere para disfrutar en familia. Como tú y tu esposo no tienen certificación, pueden hacer el **minicurso de buceo**; también pueden hacer snorkel.

- **Tu hijo de 7 años:** snorkel, desde los 6.
- **Tus hijos de 11 y 14 años:** snorkel o minicurso de buceo, desde los 10.
- **Tú y tu esposo:** minicurso o snorkel.

El **Bubble Makers** es para niños de 8 a 10 años, así que no aplica para las edades de tus hijos. Los menores deben estar acompañados por un padre o pariente responsable.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
*Desde Cartagena* — lancha desde el Muelle de la Bodeguita · con almuerzo
• Minicurso de Buceo: 183 USD · 204 USD
• Tour de Snorkeling: 126 USD · 140 USD
*Ya en las Islas del Rosario* — recogida en tu hotel si tiene acceso por lancha · sin almuerzo
• Minicurso de Buceo: 134 USD · 149 USD
• Tour de Snorkeling: 45 USD · 50 USD

*Descuento de grupo (5 personas o más):* 10% más, que se suma al 10% online (20% en total reservando online). No es automático: hay que pedirlo al equipo antes de pagar, o se pierde. No aplica a cursos PADI.

Entonces, ¿ya estarás en las *Islas del Rosario* (salida desde las islas)? 🌴

msg: Hi, I'm a German traveler in Cartagena and I've never dived. I'd like to get my Open Water certification. How long does the course take?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The PADI Open Water course takes **2 days**. It’s a great way to start diving, and no prior certification is required.

From Cartagena, day 1 starts at **8:00 a.m. at Muelle de la Bodeguita** and includes pool training and two dives. You’ll stay overnight on the islands (accommodation isn’t included). On day 2, you complete another pool session and two dives, then return to Cartagena at **3:00 p.m.**, arriving around **4:15 p.m.** Lunch is included on day 1; day 2 lunch isn’t included.

Would you like to book the Open Water course? https://book.divingplanet.org/book/basic-course/4?language=en

msg: ¿Ella puede hacer algo en el agua? ¿Y necesitaría algún permiso médico?
reply:
Sí, puede hacer snorkel en superficie con el visto bueno de su médico. Durante el embarazo no se recomienda bucear con botella.

Para el snorkel, el contexto no indica que necesite un permiso médico específico; sí debe contar con el visto bueno de su médico. El formulario médico del centro es para cursos y minicursos.

También necesitas:
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente. El refresher es el minicurso (piscina y una inmersión con instructor) y ocupa su propio día: ese mismo día no se hace la salida de buceo. Quien viene varios días hace el refresher el primero y bucea los demás.

¿Te animas con la *salida de 2 inmersiones*, un *paquete de varios días* o un *curso avanzado*? 🌊

Accommodation isn’t included. The Cartagena departure includes boat transport, diving gear, park entrance and insurance; lunch is included on day one only. Online prices include the 10% online discount.

• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD

• 9 Dives - 4 days: 602 USD · 668 USD
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD
• 7-dive package (3 days): 432 USD · 480 USD
• 9-dive package (4 days): 544 USD · 605 USD

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Do I need a refresher since it's been so long? And how do I book?
reply:
Since it’s been more than two years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required. It’s a pool session plus one ocean dive with an instructor, and it takes its own day, so you can’t do the regular 2-dive trip on the same day. If you’ve already completed a refresher or PADI ReActivate at another center, that counts. Divers with 500+ dives or Dive Master level are reviewed by the team.

You can book the refresher online as the *Dive Mini Course*: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en. The online booking includes a 10% discount. The meeting point is Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.; the return to Cartagena is estimated at 4:15 p.m. Please bring your certified diver card. The refresher requires a medical form, which is in Spanish: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

And how many people should I plan for? 😊

No, no hacemos recogidas en Barú; es distinto de las Islas del Rosario. Como se alojan en Barú, tendrían que llegar por su cuenta al *Muelle de la Bodeguita* en Cartagena, a las *8:00 a. m.*. No hay recogida en hoteles de Cartagena y el transporte terrestre hasta el muelle no está incluido.

Para el snorkel, el regreso a Cartagena es a las 3:00 p. m. (llegada estimada a las 4:15 p. m.).

¿Saldrías *desde Cartagena* o ya estás *en las Islas del Rosario*? Así te paso el plan exacto. 🌊

msg: Mi madre es vegetariana y tiene 68 años. ¿Hay almuerzo para ella y algún problema por la edad? ¿Se puede llevar una maleta o bebidas alcohólicas?
reply:
Sí, hay almuerzo vegetariano: arroz con vegetales. La edad de tu madre no es un problema para hacer snorkel; la edad mínima es 6 años y no hay edad máxima.

En la lancha pueden llevar una mochila o un bolso por persona. Si necesitan llevar una maleta, hay que coordinarlo con un asesor; también pueden dejarla en nuestra oficina de Cartagena. No se permite llevar ni consumir bebidas alcohólicas en la lancha ni durante la actividad.

msg: We'd like a day with 2 dives next Friday. What's the deadline to book, and how do we pay?
reply:
For the regular certified 2-dive trip from Cartagena, the online price is **USD 178 per person** (the 10% online discount is applied automatically). It includes the boat, diving equipment, two guided reef dives, lunch, insurance, and the National Park entrance fee. Book here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

The website closes bookings at **4:30 p.m. the day before** the trip. International guests pay 100% by card on the website; if using a foreign card, use your passport as the ID document. Payment is recorded right away, and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking.

The adaptive-diving price and arrangements are handled by the team.

In our *DIVE TO HEAL* program (adaptive diving), the price and logistics are arranged individually based on the activity and each person's needs — so it isn't a fixed website rate; an advisor sets it after evaluating your case, so the experience is safe and tailored to you. 🤿

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Would you like me to connect you with an advisor for all the details? 😊

msg: Un detalle: mi esposo buceó por última vez en abril de 2022 y yo en enero de este año, en Capurganá. ¿Eso cambia algo para él?
reply:
Sí. Como la última inmersión de tu esposo fue en abril de 2022, normalmente necesitaría hacer un *refresh* antes de volver a bucear. Es el minicurso, con práctica en piscina y una inmersión con instructor, y ocupa un día completo; como estarán varios días, podría hacerlo el primer día y bucear los siguientes. Si ya hizo un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, eso cuenta y podría bucear directamente.

También necesitas:
• Ser buzo certificado y presentar tu carnet
• Con este plan debes alojarte 1 noche en las Islas del Rosario (hotel no incluido)
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente. El refresher es el minicurso (piscina y una inmersión con instructor) y ocupa su propio día: ese mismo día no se hace la salida de buceo. Quien viene varios días hace el refresher el primero y bucea los demás.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

🤿 *Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas)*
💰 *1.154.000 COP* por persona · 2 personas

El pago es en pesos colombianos (COP): pueden pagar *100 % online* o un *anticipo del 50 %* con el enlace, el QR o Llave que envía el asesor, y el *otro 50 % el día de la actividad*.

¿Quieren que les pase con un asesor para reservar y coordinar el pago? 🌊

msg: ¿Qué incluye cada salida? Queremos saber si hay que llevar almuerzo y si el transporte hasta el muelle corre por nuestra cuenta.
reply:
El paquete de 4 inmersiones incluye la lancha rápida de Cartagena a las islas y de regreso, el equipo de buceo, el seguro obligatorio, la entrada al Parque Nacional Natural y el aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL. También incluye almuerzo el primer día; para el segundo día sí deben llevar o comprar su comida.

El transporte terrestre hasta el Muelle de la Bodeguita corre por cuenta de ustedes. El encuentro es a las 8:00 a. m., en el muelle, a 5 minutos del centro histórico; no hay recogida en hoteles. El alojamiento en las islas tampoco está incluido y deben reservarlo directamente con el hotel.

msg: Great, thanks. So the plan would be: my husband diving, our 11-year-old trying scuba for the first time, and me and our 6-year-old snorkeling, all on December 3 from Hotel Cocoliso. We're US citizens. How do we book and pay?
reply:
Perfect! For your family’s plan from Hotel Cocoliso, book the *Dive Mini Course* for your 11-year-old and *Snorkeling* for you and your 6-year-old using the links below. Your husband can join certified fun dives; the booking link for that activity is also included. Choose December 3 and the number of participants in each activity’s booking calendar.

- *Dive Mini Course:* https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en
- *Snorkeling:* https://book.divingplanet.org/book/snorkeling-already-on-the-island/25?language=en
- *Fun Dives — 2 dives:* https://book.divingplanet.org/book/fun-dives-already-on-island/19?language=en

The website applies the 10% online discount automatically. As US citizens, you pay in USD by card on the website. Payment is recorded right away, then the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking. If online payment fails, the team can provide a bank-transfer payment link.

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

For the one who hasn't chosen yet I'd recommend these options. Which one do they like best? 🐠
• *Certified diving* — Guided dives for already-certified divers; explore the reef at depth.
• *Dive mini-course* — A first time underwater with an instructor: pool training and a real dive. No experience needed.
• *Open Water course* — Entry certification course: qualifies you to dive independently down to 18 m.
• *Snorkeling* — Enjoy the reef from the surface, with mask and fins. Great for families.
• *Come along as a companion* — Comes on the boat and enjoys the day with the group, without getting in the water.

msg: A health question: my partner had asthma as a child and used an inhaler, but hasn't needed it in more than ten years. Is that a problem for the mini course? Is there a form to fill in?
reply:
A team member needs to review your partner’s specific case, so I can’t determine whether it’s a problem for the mini-course. The medical form is required for mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (it’s in Spanish).

You'll also need:
• Be ready at 9:30 a.m. at your hotel
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• After diving, wait at least 12 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.

For specific medical questions, it's important that you speak with our qualified staff so they can assess your particular situation. I'm passing you now to someone from our team, who will write to you here shortly.

You'll also need:
• Be ready at 9:30 a.m. at your hotel
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• After diving, wait at least 12 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.

For the one who hasn't chosen yet I'd recommend these options. Which one do they like best? 🐠
• *Dive mini-course* — A first time underwater with an instructor: pool training and a real dive. No experience needed.
• *Open Water course* — Entry certification course: qualifies you to dive independently down to 18 m.
• *Snorkeling* — Enjoy the reef from the surface, with mask and fins. Great for families.
• *Come along as a companion* — Comes on the boat and enjoys the day with the group, without getting in the water.

msg: ¿Cómo es el curso Open Water con ustedes? ¿Cuántos días dura, hay que estudiar algo antes y se puede ir y volver a Cartagena cada día?
reply:
¡Es una experiencia buenísima para empezar a bucear! El Open Water dura **2 días** y combina teoría, práctica en piscina y **4 inmersiones en aguas abiertas**. Al terminar, obtienes la certificación PADI para bucear hasta **18 metros**.

Antes de la parte práctica debes completar la teoría en **PADI eLearning**, que toma aproximadamente **10 a 12 horas**. No se puede ir y volver a Cartagena cada día: el primer día te quedas en las islas y necesitas reservar **al menos una noche de alojamiento**, que no está incluido.

También necesitas:
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.

Antes de la parte práctica debes completar la teoría en **PADI eLearning**, que toma aproximadamente **10 a 12 horas**. No se puede ir y volver a Cartagena cada día: el primer día te quedas en las islas y necesitas reservar **al menos una noche de alojamiento**, que no está incluido.
